style.styleTitle: Homcom 4Ft Popup Artificial Christmas Tree With Automatic Open Design
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Make your Christmas pretty in pink - make it with this artificial tree from HOMCOM. Its 4ft height is perfect for smaller rooms, with 341 branch tips for a full and voluptuous look which stands beautifully. Its sturdy composition means it can hold both decorations and tinsel properly in place - it s easy to decorate it how you like. </p><p>Comes complete with a base to stand upright; top branch allows room for your topper.</p><ul><li>Pink colour is vibrant and modern;</li><li>341 branches for a full look which holds your decorations in place;</li><li>4ft size suitable for small and medium spaces in the home and office;</li><li>Removable base to keep tree balanced;</li><li>Easy-to-fit-together pieces, easy to set up and take down;</li><li>Straight top branch for holding star/angel topper;</li><li>Recommended 15-20 minutes set up;</li><li>Ornaments in image not included;</li><li>Tree Color: Pink;</li><li>Materials: PVC, PE, Steel;</li><li>Overall Dimension: F86 x 120Hcm;</li><li>Tree Height: 4FT;</li><li>Tip count: 341(PVC:253, PE: 88);</li><li>Item Label: 830-355</li></ul>
